name: Satte (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Satte city emblem in red: an outlined cherry blossom enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Satte, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 7 November 1980.

features.role: Satte city emblem — an outlined cherry blossom enclosing a stylised character
